name: National Residence Card

requirements.blocker_text: Legal, uninterrupted residence in Hungary for at least 3 years immediately preceding the application.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 3 years of continuous legal Hungarian residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Sufficient means of subsistence via bank savings certificates, property ownership, employment income, or family-member support declarations.
Evidence of ownership or a legal right to use residential property in Hungary.
Must pass a certificate exam in Hungarian cultural knowledge, and provide clean criminal record documentation (limited exemptions for children under 14).
Dependent family member who has lived together with a qualifying sponsor for at least 1 year.
Must pass a certificate exam in Hungarian cultural knowledge, and provide clean criminal record documentation (limited exemptions for children under 14).
Spouse of a Hungarian citizen, married for at least 2 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 2 years of marriage to a Hungarian citizen.

requirements.blocker_text: Must pass a certificate exam in Hungarian cultural knowledge, and provide clean criminal record documentation (limited exemptions for children under 14).
Applicant is a former Hungarian citizen, or a descendant of one.
Must pass a certificate exam in Hungarian cultural knowledge, and provide clean criminal record documentation (limited exemptions for children under 14).

evidence_required.document: Proof of the qualifying residence/family-tie ground
Bank savings certificate, property ownership, or income verification

outcome.duration_length: indefinite residence status; card issued for up to 10 years, renewable for further 10-year periods

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- National Residence Card: 3-year residence / dependent-family-member / spouse-of-citizen / former-citizen-or-descendant grounds, cultural-knowledge exam, 10-year renewable card, no automatic citizenship pathway

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. The source explicitly states this card 'does not provide automatic path to citizenship' -- leads_to_citizenship is nonetheless set true because holding it counts as ordinary legal residence toward hu_naturalisation's general 8-year (or 3-year reduced) track, not because the card itself confers any accelerated or automatic route; citizenship_after_months left null accordingly. EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED from ever qualifying for this card by their own permits' terms: hu_guest_worker and hu_guest_self_employment (both state outright that holders 'may not be granted a national residence card'). hu_white_card is not explicitly barred in this source, but its hard 2-year duration cap falls well short of the 3-year continuous-residence ground in practice. A parallel 'EC Permanent Residence Permit' (the EU Long-Term Residence Directive status, legally distinct from this NATIONAL card) is referenced in oif.gov.hu's own site navigation but its specific requirements could not be confirmed at tier-1 in this pass -- the linked factsheet page returned only site navigation, no substantive content -- and is therefore not modelled as a separate route pending clearer sourcing.
